candidates.detail: bmoe-cli --help has no --perplexity/--ppl/--logprob. TokenMetrics (metrics.h) has wall/io/mgmt/compute/stall/cache_hit but no logprob/NLL. Source core/cli: no logprob export path.

llama-perplexity binary NOT present in build-safe2/bin (only llama-cli, llama-bench). CMakeFiles for perplexity exist as incomplete build dirs. Even if rebuilt: without moe-stream it mmaps the full 11.5GB model and falls into F3 wall (~0.10 tok/s). Not usable for a night baseline on this phone.
No per-token logprob surface from bmoe-cli (progress JSON, CSV sink, or stdout). Cannot compute PPL by hand without log p(token).

what_is_missing: Either: bmoe-cli flag to emit per-token logprob/NLL under moe-stream (preferred: keeps streaming path)
Or: llama-perplexity built AND a streaming/lazy-expert path so it does not mmap the whole 11.5GB
Corpus prep script is ready (see scripts/quality/prepare_it_ppl_corpus.py) but unused until tool exists
notes: Deterministic quality meter is blocked on tooling, not on battery/charge. Do not invent a proxy. STOP after feasibility as mandated.
